import semver

# R1: Immutability - accessing attributes should be fine, but modifying should raise AttributeError
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
print("R1 check:", end=" ")
try:
    v.major = 5
    print("FAIL - no error raised")
except AttributeError:
    print("PASS")

# R2: Iteration
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, "alpha", "build.1")
vals = list(v)
print(f"R2 check: {vals} == [1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build.1']: {'PASS' if vals == [1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build.1'] else 'FAIL'}")

# R3: Comparison with tuple
v1 = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
v2 = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 4)
print(f"R3a check: (1,2,3) < (1,2,4): {v1 < (1,2,4)}")
print(f"R3b check: (1,2,3) == (1,2,3): {v1 == (1,2,3)}")
# Disallowed with string/int
try:
    v1 < "1.2.3"
    print("R3c check: FAIL - should disallow string comparison")
except TypeError:
    print("R3c check: PASS - string comparison disallowed")

try:
    v1 < 1
    print("R3d check: FAIL - should disallow int comparison")
except TypeError:
    print("R3d check: PASS - int comparison disallowed")

# R4: Bump methods
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
print(f"R4a: bump_major: {v.bump_major()}")
print(f"R4b: bump_minor: {v.bump_minor()}")
print(f"R4c: bump_patch: {v.bump_patch()}")
print(f"R4d: bump_prerelease: {v.bump_prerelease()}")
print(f"R4e: bump_build: {v.bump_build()}")

# R5: Type conversion in __init__
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, prerelease="alpha", build="123")
print(f"R5 check: prerelease type={type(v.prerelease).__name__}, build type={type(v.build).__name__}")

# R6: CLI functions exposed
print(f"R6 check: createparser={hasattr(semver, 'createparser')}, main={hasattr(semver, 'main')}, process={hasattr(semver, 'process')}")

# R7: replace function and method
new_ver = semver.replace("1.2.3", major=2)
print(f"R7a: module replace: {new_ver}")
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
new_v = v.replace(major=2)
print(f"R7b: instance replace: {new_v}")
